crossRefs.note: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.
translations.bsb: No city made peace with the Israelites except the Hivites living in Gibeon; all others were taken in battle.
translations.kjv: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
translations.asv: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: they took all in battle.
